name: WP Flashcard LITE
author: WP Flashcard

sections.description:
WP Flashcard LITE is a simple, fast way to add interactive flashcards to your WordPress site. Create a flashcard set, add up to 10 cards, and embed it on any page or post with a shortcode.

Cards flip with a smooth animation, work great on mobile, and require no page builder or extra setup. Perfect for teachers, tutors, course creators, and anyone helping people learn.

LITE features

  • One flashcard set with up to 10 cards
  • Clean, responsive flip-card study view
  • Simple shortcode embedding: [flashcard_set id="123"]
  • Fast and lightweight — no bloat
  • Works with any theme

Upgrade to WP Flashcard (full version)

The full version of WP Flashcard removes all limits and adds:

  • Unlimited flashcard sets and unlimited cards
  • Images, audio, and video on cards
  • CSV import
  • Add-ons: AI Generator, Spaced Repetition, Bulk Toolkit, and Animations & Sounds

Learn more at wpflashcard.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wp-flashcard-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Flashcards in the admin menu and create your set.
  4. Copy the shortcode shown for your set and paste it into any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I display a flashcard set?

Each set has a shortcode like [flashcard_set id="123"]. Copy it from the set’s edit screen and paste it into any page or post.

What are the limits in the LITE version?

LITE allows one flashcard set with up to 10 cards. For unlimited sets and cards, plus media, CSV import, and add-ons, upgrade to the full version of WP Flashcard.

Can I use LITE and the full version at the same time?

No. The full version of WP Flashcard replaces LITE. If both are installed, LITE automatically deactivates so your data is served by the full version.
